shell.title: Platform
shell.subtitle: All organizations
shell.footer: Platform admin console · operator, cross-organization access

forbidden.title: You need platform-admin access
forbidden.description: You're signed in, but you're not a platform administrator. This console operates across every organization — ask an existing platform admin to grant you access.

activeImpersonations.title: Active impersonations
activeImpersonations.subtitle: Every "view as" session in progress, across every org.
activeImpersonations.forceStopHint: Force stop ends the session record; the target's impersonation cookie expires on its own (max 60 min).

empty.title: No active impersonations
empty.description: Sessions started via Users → Impersonate will appear here.

technologies.title: Technologies
technologies.subtitle: Manage the public catalog and review organization or platform submissions before publication.
technologies.bulkPublishFailed: {{count}} reviews could not be published. They remain selected.
technologies.emptyDescription: Organization submissions will appear here after private approval.
technologies.publishDescription: Creates a new approved public identity and redirects the submitted private identity to it.
technologies.mergeSameTechnology: A technology cannot be merged into itself.
technologies.mergeComparatorDescription: Compare the {{proposal}} proposal with the canonical {{public}} record. This decision creates a new audited public revision.
technologies.reasonPlaceholder: Explain the required changes or rejection…
technologies.actionFailed: Failed to apply the review decision
technologies.catalogEmptyDescription: Try another search or create a public draft.
technologies.catalogIconHint: Choose the light and dark immutable artwork from the shared icon catalog.
technologies.iconOrgRequiredDescription: Select an organization context for this platform-admin session before uploading governed light and dark icon assets.
technologies.aiDescription: Uses the name and every non-empty field as context. Empty fields are completed automatically; suggested changes to existing values stay reviewable.
technologies.aiOrgRequired: AI Assist requires a platform administrator session pinned to an organization.
technologies.aiNotConfiguredDescription: Configure AI Assist for your current organization before researching public technology metadata.
technologies.aiImprovementHint: Existing values are never overwritten automatically. Review this action before applying the suggested changes.
technologies.otherReviewerRequired: A different platform administrator must make this review decision.
technologies.platformPublishDescription: Approves this public revision and makes it available to organizations.

empty.title: No organizations found
empty.createFirst: Create the first org to get started.

create.title: Create organization
create.name: Name
create.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only — this becomes part of URLs and can't be changed later.
create.slugInvalid: Only lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens are allowed.
create.slugTaken: That slug is already taken — try a different one.

suspendModal.suspendDescription: Suspending {{name}} drops every live session in this org immediately and blocks all sign-ins until it's unsuspended. Members will see a suspended-org message.
suspendModal.unsuspendDescription: This restores access for {{name}} — members will be able to sign in again.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Every user account on the platform, across every organization.

empty.title: No users found
empty.willAppear: Users will appear here once they sign in.

deactivateModal.deactivateDescription: Deactivating {{email}} signs them out everywhere and blocks further sign-ins, across every organization they belong to.

adminModal.grantDescription: {{email}} will get full operator access — every organization, every user, impersonation, and platform-level settings.
adminModal.revokeDescription: {{email}} will lose operator access. They keep their normal org memberships.
adminModal.lastPlatformAdmin: This is the last platform admin — grant admin to someone else before revoking this one.

access.title: Access
access.subtitle: The org-admin grant matrix, filtered by organization — pick an org to view and edit its access.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure global governance behavior for every platform administrator.

governance.title: Governance
governance.description: Controls for platform-level review and approval workflows.

independentReview.title: Require independent technology review
independentReview.description: When enabled, the administrator who creates or submits a public technology revision cannot approve, reject, or request changes on that same revision.
independentReview.soleAdminDescription: There is only one active platform administrator. That administrator can decide their own public technology reviews until another active administrator is added.
independentReview.effectiveDescription: A different platform administrator must decide public technology revisions created or submitted by another administrator.
independentReview.disabledTitle: Self-review is allowed by platform policy
independentReview.disabledDescription: Any platform administrator can decide a public technology review, including one they created or submitted.

audit.title: Audit
audit.subtitle: Every mutation across every organization, plus platform-level events.

empty.title: No audit entries found
empty.description: Try clearing the filters, or check back after some activity.

debug.title: Access debug
debug.subtitle: Check exactly what a user can do on a scope, and why — the RLS decision trace, cross-org.

referenceIntegrity.title: Reference integrity
referenceIntegrity.description: Cross-entity references whose target no longer exists. Scanning is read-only; repair is opt-in, defaults to a dry run, and is always scoped to one workspace.
referenceIntegrity.walkDocumentsHint: Opens one document per diagram — slower, and the only way to see group parents, layout keys and flow-step references.
referenceIntegrity.walkDocumentsNeedsWorkspace: Needs a landscape and version: the walk is per-workspace.

empty.title: No dangling references found
empty.description: Every reference this scan can check resolves. See the coverage note below for what it did not look at.

coverage.title: What this scan did not check
coverage.unchecked: Never checked, deliberately: {{kinds}}. Skins are client plugins the server cannot resolve, and a comment lives inside its diagram document so it cannot dangle.
coverage.documentsNotWalked: The Automerge documents were not walked, so group parents, layout keys and flow-step references were not checked.
coverage.diagramsSkipped: {{count}} diagram document(s) were not opened because the walk hit its cap.
coverage.truncated: The result was cut short by a cap, so these counts are lower bounds.

repair.title: Repair
repair.description: A dry run reports what would change and writes nothing. Apply is only offered for findings the server judged safe.
repair.needsWorkspace: Repair needs a landscape and version — it is never fleet-wide.
